description: Self-hosted co-op server for Prison Architect (pa-coop). Players install the pa-coop mod and point it to this server's address and port. One TCP port.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# pa-coop : télécharge le serveur depuis les releases GitHub
set -e
cd /mnt/server
REPO=fabienmillet/prison-architect-server
if [ -z "$VERSION" ] || [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
  URL=https://github.com/$REPO/releases/latest/download/pacoop-server-linux-amd64
else
  URL=https://github.com/$REPO/releases/download/$VERSION/pacoop-server-linux-amd64
fi
echo "Téléchargement de $URL"
curl -fsSL -o pacoop-server "$URL"
chmod +x pacoop-server
echo "pa-coop installé"
